fields.acceptance: In a testscript (beside or extending import-autonomous-decisions.txtar), rhiza guide import prints both wording forms and when each applies; a repo holding one decision of each form, each derived-from its Source and with no quote field, lands and passes rhiza check (fold-ok), and rhiza why shows each decision's wording and its Source.
fields.statement: The import procedure's step 4 gives a second wording form for a decision its document records the owner making or confirming, '<decided>, made by the owner as recorded in <document>', with no quote field and a derived-from link to the document's Source, beside the agent-made form for every other imported decision.
